archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark Premium Tech Edition)
design_philosophy: A cinematic, moody, and highly functional dark-first interface. Prioritizes negative space, stark contrast, and premium tactical aesthetics over generic 'tech dark mode'. Employs 'The Tracing Beam' and 'Glassmorphism' micro-themes for floating elements.

onboarding_carousel.description: 3-step interactive intro carousel telling the app's story.
onboarding_carousel.effects: Floating font effects using staggered entry animations (transform: translateY + opacity). Images should sit as full-screen backgrounds with a dark gradient overlay (bg-black/60 to bg-black/90 at bottom) to ensure text readability.
onboarding_carousel.animation: react-native-reanimated for smooth parallax scroll and floating text elements. Elements should 'breathe' with a slow vertical sine-wave translation.

buttons.primary: Solid #007AFF background, Stark White text. Add a subtle 'Tracing Beam' or glowing drop-shadow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,122,255,0.4)]) for the special effect user requested.
buttons.social_auth: Solid #111111 background, 1px border #27272A, with brand logo on the left.

kanban_board.card: Dark glass cards. bg-[#111111] with 1px border-[#27272A]. Hover/Active state lifts the card slightly (-translate-y-1) and brightens the border to rgba(255,255,255,0.2).
kanban_board.interaction: Smooth drag-and-drop powered by Reanimated/Gesture Handler. Haptic feedback on pickup and drop.

modals_and_sheets.smart_detection_popup: Bottom sheet or modal. Glassmorphism effect: backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-[#111111]/80, 1px top border of border-white/10.
modals_and_sheets.add_application_form: Minimalist inputs. Dark surface, floating labels, active input highlighted with a 1px solid primary color border.

floating_text_effects.implementation: Use split-text staggered animations for headings on the onboarding screens. Words should slide up and fade in sequentially. Incorporate 'blur-in' effects if possible.

onboarding_bg_1.description: 3D gold/silver particles sphere for AI Parsing slide

onboarding_bg_2.description: Wavy metallic surface for Kanban/Tracking slide

onboarding_bg_3.description: Blue and white light digital wallpaper for Analytics slide

google_logo.description: Google standard icon for OAuth button

testing_attributes.convention: Kebab-case, role-based standard testID for React Native

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the premium dark tech theme consistently across all files.
Implement the 2-3 onboarding slides in /app/frontend/app/index.js using the specified background images and staggered floating text animations.
For floating font effects, utilize react-native-reanimated or similar animation libraries to stagger the entrance of headings and provide a continuous slow translation.
Buttons must have a premium feel: use dark solid backgrounds with primary color accents or subtle glows for primary CTAs.
Kanban Board should avoid generic gray cards. Use deep blacks (#111111) with a sharp 1px border (#27272A).
Ensure the Smart Detection popup feels 'glassy' and elevated compared to the base app background.
No credentials should be hardcoded in the frontend. Use environment variables.
Ensure all interactive elements have a 'testID' attribute following the testing convention.
